methodHandling.otherMethods: 405 {"error":"GET, POST or DELETE only"} - but only after requireAdmin, so non-admins get 401/403 first.

auth.notes: First statement; the test asserts 403 before any DB access.

query.name: domain
query.parse: trim().toLowerCase() only. NOT run through normalizeDomain: no '@' stripping, no format or public-provider check.
query.invalidBehaviour: Any string; deleting an unmapped domain still returns {ok:true}.

query.name: brandId
query.parse: used only if `domain` is absent/empty (domain wins when both given)
query.invalidBehaviour: not an org brand, or malformed id -> 404 'Organization brand not found'

request.parse: POST: `await req.json().catch(() => null)`; null (malformed JSON, empty body, JSON null, JSON 0/false/'') -> 400 'Invalid JSON body'. A JSON array or truthy primitive passes and fails the action check with 400 'action must be createBrand or addDomain'.

fields.name: action
fields.validation: anything else -> 400 'action must be createBrand or addDomain'

fields.name: name (createBrand)
fields.validation: non-string, blank or >120 after trim -> 400 'name is required (1-120 characters)'. Stored trimmed.

fields.name: brandId (addDomain)
fields.validation: non-string/empty -> 400 'brandId is required'; not an existing is_org brand (or a malformed id causing a Postgres error) -> 404 'Organization brand not found'. Checked BEFORE domain.

fields.name: domain (addDomain)
fields.bounds: regex ^[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$ after trim, lowercase, one leading '@' stripped
fields.validation: non-string -> 400 'domain is required'; regex fail -> 400 'Enter a bare domain like acme.com'; in the 24-entry public provider list -> 400 '<d> is a public email provider and can't be mapped to a brand'

checkOrder: GET: brands + domains in parallel, then one count query per domain (:67-86)

POST: parse (:89-90) -> action -> createBrand: validName -> insertOrgBrand (:92-94); addDomain: requireOrgBrand -> normalizeDomain -> existing mapping lookup -> 200 same brand / 409 other brand / insert 201 (:96-113)
DELETE: domain first, else brandId (requireOrgBrand then delete), else 400 (:118-134)

bodyShape.brands: [{id, name, kit (raw jsonb), updatedAt, domains: [{domain, accounts:int}]}] all is_org brands ordered by name; domains ordered by domain

responses.when: POST addDomain, domain already mapped to the SAME brand (idempotent)
DELETE ?domain= (whether or not it was mapped) or DELETE ?brandId= of an existing org brand (domains cascade in DB)

errors.when: POST body unparseable or falsy JSON
addDomain brandId not a non-empty string
addDomain or DELETE ?brandId= for a missing/non-org/malformed id

body.error: Enter a bare domain like acme.com

errors.when: domain fails regex (e.g. an email address, single label)

body.error: gmail.com is a public email provider and can't be mapped to a brand

errors.when: domain in PUBLIC_EMAIL_DOMAINS (message templated with the normalized domain)

body.error: acme.com is already mapped to "Other Brand" — remove it there first

errors.when: domain mapped to a different brand; the brand name comes from the brands(name) join, 'another brand' if unavailable. Note the em dash (U+2014).

body.error: action must be createBrand or addDomain

errors.when: any Supabase error in GET, insert (incl. a unique-violation race on insert), lookup or delete

sideEffects: createBrand: inserts brands {user_id: calling admin, name, kit: {}, is_org: true} (db.ts:275-283). The creating admin's id becomes the blob namespace for the brand's assets.
addDomain: inserts org_brand_domains {domain, brand_id, created_by: admin} (admin-org-brands.ts:110).
DELETE ?domain: deletes from org_brand_domains (:123). DELETE ?brandId: deletes the brands row where is_org (:129); domain rows cascade (per the header comment :14). Blobs are not deleted.
quirks: The createBrand 201 body includes `isOrg: true` (added in insertOrgBrand), although the handler's header comment says { id, name, kit }.
addDomain is idempotent for the same brand (200, not 201) and conflicts with 409 for another brand.
requireOrgBrand runs before domain validation, so a bad brandId with a bad domain yields 404, not 400.
DELETE ?domain= does not normalise like POST does (no '@' strip) and never 404s.
When both domain and brandId are given on DELETE, only the domain is removed.
GET `accounts` counts profiles.email ILIKE '%@<domain>' (a sign-up snapshot), not authoritative membership (:51-60). One count query per domain (N+1).
GET returns the raw kit jsonb, not normalised.

tests.asserts: normalizeDomain: trims/lowercases/strips '@'; rejects non-domains and emails; refuses public providers. Handler: 403 for non-admins before DB; createBrand 201 owned by the calling admin; addDomain 201; 409 when mapped to a different brand; 404 when the brand is not an org brand; 400 on unknown action.

callers.where: src/lib/api.ts:383-401 (listOrgBrands GET, createOrgBrand POST createBrand, addOrgBrandDomain POST addDomain, removeOrgBrandDomain DELETE ?domain=, deleteOrgBrand DELETE ?brandId=)
callers.expects: GET {brands: OrgBrandSummary[]} with updatedAt and domains[].accounts; createBrand {id, name}; addDomain {domain, brandId}; DELETE {ok}. Errors surfaced via body.error (src/lib/api.ts:14-19).

planSection65: Row says `DELETE ?domain=&brandId=` and `201 {domain, brandId} / brand; {ok:true}`. Corrections: DELETE takes ?domain= OR ?brandId= (domain wins if both); addDomain returns 200 when already mapped to the same brand; createBrand 201 body is {id, name, kit:{}, isOrg:true}; plus 405 for other methods.
